name: CM43_primes_are_forever
origins: user requirement 2026-10-22 (a universal Gödel model that keeps expanding)
statement: The Gödel model's atoms take primes in an append-only ledger: an atom keeps its prime forever, a new atom takes the next unused prime, and no line is renumbered or removed. A concept's content vector (its factorization over the atoms) and its structural number (Gödel's positional numbering, the identity) are computed from the ledger; carrying between Gödel sets is a map of atoms, which preserves every GCD exactly when distinct atoms go to disjoint supports, and whose gap is what it cannot send.
